Generate Crop Coefficient (Kc) Curve

Source: R/calc_kc_curve.R
calc_kc_curve.Rd

Constructs a time series of daily crop coefficient (\(K_c\)) values and generates a ggplot2 visualization representing the \(K_c\) curve across the crop cycle, following FAO-56 guidelines. The curve is divided into four distinct stages: initial, development, mid-season, and late-season.

Usage

calc_kc_curve(kc_points, stage_lengths, crop = NULL)

Arguments

kc_points

Numeric vector of length 3 containing the crop coefficients for the initial stage (\(K_{c\text{ ini}}\)), mid-season stage (\(K_{c\text{ mid}}\)), and end of the late-season stage (\(K_{c\text{ end}}\)).

stage_lengths

Numeric vector of length 4 containing the duration (in days) of each growth stage: initial (\(L_{\text{ini}}\)), development (\(L_{\text{dev}}\)), mid-season (\(L_{\text{mid}}\)), and late-season (\(L_{\text{late}}\)).

crop

Character string (optional). Name of the crop, used to customize the plot title. Defaults to NULL.

Value

A named list containing:

  • kc_serie: A numeric vector of daily \(K_c\) values over the entire cycle.

  • kc_plot: A ggplot2 object displaying the constructed curve and stage markers.

  • kc_data: A tibble::tibble() containing the simulation days and corresponding \(K_c\) values.

References

Allen, R. G., Pereira, L. S., Raes, D., & Smith, M. (1998). Crop evapotranspiration - Guidelines for computing crop water requirements. FAO Irrigation and drainage paper 56. Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, Rome.

Examples

kc_params <- c(0.7, 1.0, 0.95)
stage_durations <- c(15, 20, 20, 10)
lettuce_kc <- calc_kc_curve(
  kc_points = kc_params,
  stage_lengths = stage_durations,
  crop = "Lettuce"
)

print(lettuce_kc$kc_data)
#> # A tibble: 65 × 2
#>      day kc_value
#>    <int>    <dbl>
#>  1     1      0.7
#>  2     2      0.7
#>  3     3      0.7
#>  4     4      0.7
#>  5     5      0.7
#>  6     6      0.7
#>  7     7      0.7
#>  8     8      0.7
#>  9     9      0.7
#> 10    10      0.7
#> # ℹ 55 more rows
print(lettuce_kc$kc_plot)
